description: Upgrade plan to migrate project to latest LTS versions

tasks.requirements: Upgrade JDK to version 21, update build configuration files (pom.xml or build.gradle) to target Java 21, and ensure all language features are compatible with Java 21
tasks.summary: Successfully upgraded Java from 1.8 to 21. Updated build configurations in demo/pom.xml and democlient/pom.xml. Both projects build successfully and all tests pass.

tasks.requirements: Upgrade Spring Boot to version 3.4, Spring Framework to 6.x, migrate javax.* packages to jakarta.* namespace, update dependencies to Spring Boot 3.4 compatible versions, and address any breaking changes in configuration and APIs
tasks.summary: Successfully upgraded Spring Boot to 3.4.0 with Spring Framework 6.x. Migrated from javax.* to jakarta.* namespace. Converted architecture from Java EE/Servlet WAR to Spring Boot JAR. Modernized to use Spring AMQP and Spring WebSocket. All builds pass and tests succeed.
